checks.name: Signed price sync, replay rejection, invalid signatures, foreign target, downgrade/conflict and discount/missing/fractional validation
Changed price invalidates the persisted quote without debit or entitlement
Zero-Credit activation is explicit, audited, 20-way idempotent, has no ledger entry, no placement, bounded renewal and owner-only access
Existing moderator pin flags alone control pin ordering, independently of active SEO
Free edits preserve terms; newly reserved topics immediately lose SEO effect while immutable history/calendar remain; commercial history cannot become editorial
20 concurrent real PostgreSQL purchases spend only 15 of 16 Credit; exact immutable paid/list/version snapshots and no overspend
Mid-transaction event failure rolls back debit/purchase/entitlement; mandatory policy BLOCK and moderation pending deny activation
Products, purchases and events are immutable; privileged correction appends one linked compensation
Vietnam calendar months clamp January 29–31 correctly, handle leap years and preserve local time across UTC midnight
Near-expiry monthly renewal extends exactly; expired renewal starts now; delayed/concurrent workers cannot preserve privileges; hiding/cancellation never refund
Authoritative interval changes without cron; crossing the scheduled boundary invalidates the old zero quote; Vietnam midnight maps to UTC exactly
Exact Vietnam 23:59:59 to 00:00:00 boundary selects zero then five Credit using the production database price selector
Disabled products and expired latest snapshots are unavailable, with no fallback to obsolete or invented pricing
